# dreamrouter_status (Data Source)

An overview of the router: versions, internet connection, load, client counts, firmware and the last speed test. Most values change all the time; the stable ones, such as the WAN IP address and the versions, are the useful inputs elsewhere, e.g. the WAN IP in a DNS record at another provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dreamrouter_status" "router" {}

output "wan_ip" {
  value = data.dreamrouter_status.router.wan_ip
}

output "firmware" {
  value = {
    for d in data.dreamrouter_status.router.devices : d.name => d.upgradable ? "${d.version} (update: ${d.upgrade_to})" : d.version
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `access_points` (Number) Access points, including the router's built-in Wi-Fi.
- `asn` (Number) The internet provider's autonomous system number.
- `clients` (Number) Clients connected now.
- `cpu_percent` (Number) The router's CPU use in percent.
- `cpu_temperature` (Number) The router's CPU temperature in °C; 0 if not reported.
- `devices` (Attributes List) The UniFi devices: the router itself, access points and switches. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--devices))
- `internet_status` (String) "ok" when the internet is reachable; otherwise e.g. "warning" or "error".
- `isp` (String) The internet provider's name.
- `latency_ms` (Number) Latency to the internet in milliseconds.
- `memory_percent` (Number) The router's memory use in percent.
- `model` (String) The router's model code, e.g. "UDMA67A".
- `name` (String) The router's name, e.g. "Dream Router 7".
- `network_version` (String) UniFi Network application version, e.g. "10.6.106".
- `os_version` (String) UniFi OS version, e.g. "5.1.33".
- `pppoe` (Boolean) Whether the internet connection uses PPPoE.
- `speedtest_download_mbps` (Number) Download speed in the last speed test, in Mbit/s; 0 if never run.
- `speedtest_run` (String) When the last speed test ran, as an RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC); empty if never.
- `speedtest_upload_mbps` (Number) Upload speed in the last speed test, in Mbit/s; 0 if never run.
- `switches` (Number) Switches, including the router's built-in switch.
- `timezone` (String) The router's time zone, e.g. "Europe/Dublin".
- `update_available` (Boolean) Whether the Network application or any UniFi device has an update available.
- `uptime` (Number) Seconds since the router started.
- `wan_interface` (String) The WAN port, e.g. "eth3".
- `wan_ip` (String) The public (WAN) IP address.
- `wan_link_mbps` (Number) The WAN port's link speed in Mbit/s.
- `wan_up` (Boolean) Whether the (first) WAN link is up.
- `wifi_clients` (Number) Wi-Fi clients connected now.
- `wired_clients` (Number) Wired clients connected now.

<a id="nestedatt--devices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `devices`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) IP address.
- `mac` (String) MAC address.
- `model` (String) Model code.
- `name` (String) Device name.
- `online` (Boolean) Whether the device is connected.
- `type` (String) "udm" (router), "uap" (access point), "usw" (switch), ...
- `upgradable` (Boolean) Whether a firmware update is available.
- `upgrade_to` (String) The available firmware version; empty if none.
- `version` (String) Firmware version.
